name: Under Control 3: The College
source:
We are no longer just a cog in the system, we are the system. Now everything that happens in the College is the player's choice: we set the rules, punish violators, deal with force majeure.

We start as Bina's younger daughter. Before us, the place was run by our older sister Teresa who failed. Can we do better regarding the challenges we face?

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/bit-about-uc3-108010968]Patreon[/url]]
